content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 3.4(b) conditions our convenience termination on paying "early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" — an open-ended, Customer-payable liquidated amount (and Section 3.3 confirms IBM may recover it unless IBM is in breach). With no Attachment A charge schedule in the document, the amount is effectively uncapped, so the clause fails the fallback.

**Redline (fallback, accepted):** one inserted sentence in Section 3.4 capping those charges at three months' charges for the terminated Services and making them the sole liquidated amount payable by us. We chose the fallback rather than deleting the charge, because outright deletion would leave the Section 3.3 cross-reference to Section 3.4(b) dangling. Late payment fees under Section 4.2 were reviewed and treated as a payment-timing charge, not a liquidated damages regime.
